    • findPageIds

      protected final <B> List<B> findPageIds(RepositoryMethodKey methodKey, io.micronaut.aop.MethodInvocationContext<?,?> context, Pageable pageable, jakarta.persistence.criteria.CriteriaQuery<B> criteriaQuery)
      Executes the internal ID prequery for a paged specification that contains joins or fetches. Pagination is applied to distinct root IDs before the entity query executes, because a collection join can otherwise consume a page with multiple rows for the same root. Providers may adapt this dedicated query without changing normal user criteria queries.
      Type Parameters:
      B - The ID query result type
      Parameters:
      methodKey - The repository method
      context - The invocation context
      pageable - The requested page
      criteriaQuery - The ID criteria query
      Returns:
      The page IDs
